issues.jp_before: 選手[せんしゅ]{に|te-hoshii}けが{を|o-object}しないでほしいです。
issues.problem: Distractor が is natural with an unwilled event (選手がけがをしないでほしい).
issues.action: Made が an alternative ({に/が}); replaced distractor with の; updated why.

issues.jp_before: 友達[ともだち]{に|te-hoshii}一緒[いっしょ]に山[やま]{に/へ|ni-destination}行[い]ってほしいです。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of other 友達に一緒に…てほしい items (友達 used six times).
issues.action: Changed person to 夫 and English to match.

issues.jp_before: 友達[ともだち]{に|te-hoshii}日曜日[にちようび]{に|ni-time}一緒[いっしょ]に釣[つ]り{を|o-object}してほしいです。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of item 2 (友達に一緒に…をしてほしい).
issues.action: Rewrote as 兄に日曜日に釣りに連れて行ってほしいです / take me fishing.

issues.jp_before: 先輩[せんぱい]{に|te-hoshii}このフォーム{を|o-object}直[なお]してほしいです。
issues.problem: English 'my form' did not match この ('this form').
issues.action: Changed この to 私{の|no-possessive}.

issues.jp_before: 最近[さいきん]、友達[ともだち]{と/に|to-with}会[あ]っていない{な|na-musing}。
issues.problem: Self-realization: monologue ぞ (会っていないぞ) and self-questioning か are both natural, so distractors were not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Rewrote as 会えなくて寂しいなあ (a feeling), where か/ぞ/よ fail.

issues.jp_before: この意見[いけん]{は|wa-topic}ちょっと違[ちが]う{な|na-musing}。
issues.problem: Monologue ちょっと違うぞ and musing 違うか are both natural self-talk.
issues.action: Replaced with 田中さんの考え方はすてきだな (だか is ungrammatical, ぞ/よ address a listener).

issues.jp_before: みんな{の|no-possessive}前[まえ]{で|de-place}話[はな]す{の|no-nominalizer}{は|wa-topic}緊張[きんちょう]する{な|na-musing}。
issues.problem: 緊張するな reads equally as the prohibition 'Don't be nervous'.
issues.action: Changed answer to なあ, English to 'I sigh to myself', updated why.

issues.jp_before: 友達[ともだち]{に|ni-recipient}メッセージ{を|o-object}送[おく]った{けど|kedo-but}、まだ返事[へんじ]{が|ga-subject}来[こ]ない{な|na-musing}。
issues.problem: まだ来ないか / まだ来ないぞ are natural monologue, so distractors were acceptable.
issues.action: Rewrote as 友達から返事が来て安心したなあ.

issues.jp_before: 朝[あさ]{から|kara-from}お酒[さけ]{を|o-object}飲[の]む{な|na-prohibition}。
issues.action: English changed to 'Don't start drinking first thing in the morning.'

issues.jp_before: 兄弟[きょうだい]{に|ni-target}手[て]{を|o-object}上[あ]げる{な|na-prohibition}。
issues.problem: 兄弟 means siblings, not 'your brother'.
issues.action: English changed to 'Don't raise a hand against your siblings.'
